description.p: iptux is an “IP Messenger” client for communication and file sharing on a local area network.

ul.li: auto-detect other clients on the intranet.

description.p: It is (supposedly) compatible with 飞鸽传书 (Feige) and 飞秋 (FeiQ) from China, and with the original “IP Messenger” clients from Japan, including g2ipmsg and xipmsg in Debian.
